description: This is a YAML schema defining a class-like structure 'tlvMetricReportingPolicy' and related data structures for metric reporting policies, including configuration parameters, bit fields, and nested structures used for managing metric reporting in a wireless framework.

classes.name: tlvMetricReportingPolicy
classes.description: A class representing the metric reporting policy, including type, length, interval, and configuration list.

classes.name: sPolicy
classes.description: A structure encapsulating various flags for including specific TLV metrics and reserved bits.

classes.name: sMetricsReportingConf
classes.description: A structure defining radio UID and thresholds for reporting metrics.
